query: How is the weather in Seattle?

tool_definitions.name: fetch_weather
tool_definitions.description: Fetches the weather information for the specified location.

location.description: The location to fetch weather for.

response: The weather in Seattle is currently cloudy with a temperature of 58°F.

query: Turn on the air conditioner in the living room.

tool_definitions.name: control_device
tool_definitions.description: Controls smart devices in the specified location.

response: The air conditioner in the living room has been turned on.

query: Set the air conditioner temperature to 25 degrees Celsius.

tool_definitions.name: set_device_temperature
tool_definitions.description: Sets the temperature of a device.

device.description: The device to set temperature for.

response: The air conditioner temperature has been set to 25 degrees Celsius.
